intro: Two half-boiled eggs are about 140 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the yolks, which have fat and protein.

variants.name: Set with roti bakar kaya mentega

diet: Very much yes. Half-boiled eggs are high in protein and low in calories. They help you stay full longer. Just watch what you eat with them, like toast and sweet drinks.
tips: Use a little normal soy sauce, less kicap manis.
Eat with one slice of wholemeal bread, not two.
Make them at home with hot water, ready in 6 to 7 minutes.

swap.name: 2 hard-boiled eggs
swap.why: Same calories, easy to bring to the office, and no soy sauce needed.

faq.q: Is it safe to eat half-boiled eggs?
faq.a: Generally okay if the eggs are fresh and stored properly. Pregnant mums, young kids and the elderly may be better off with fully cooked eggs.

faq.q: How do I make half-boiled eggs without a machine?
faq.a: Boil water, turn off the fire, put in the eggs and cover the pot for 6 to 7 minutes. Take them out and crack into a bowl.

faq.q: Is eating 2 eggs a day okay?
faq.a: For most healthy people, 1 to 2 eggs a day is usually okay. If you have cholesterol issues, talk to your doctor.
